page.text:
Among all binary relations, the most ubiquitous are *equivalence
relations*. An equivalence relation is simultaneously reflexive,
symmetric, and transitive. These three axioms distill the essential
properties of equality itself, allowing mathematicians to treat distinct
objects as 'the same' with respect to a specified invariant.
